candidate_windows.window_text: PLAYNTELL was trained with Graphics Processing Units (GPU). We used a 32-core Intel Xeon Gold 6134 CPU @ 3.20GHz CPU with 128GB RAM equipped with 4 GTX 1080 GPUs with 11GB RAM each. Each training phase was performed on a single GPU. Full training of a model (for a single hyper-parameter setting) was about 20 hours.
